name: JavaBench
description: JavaBench is a project-level Java benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on object-oriented programming features such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. It consists of four Java projects with 389 methods in 106 classes, high test coverage, and is validated by undergraduate students to ensure quality.
reputation: A recent project-level Java benchmark that has been used in LLM coding evaluations, but it is not yet as widely established as long-running benchmarks like HumanEval or SWE-bench.
notes: Addresses imbalances in programming language and code granularity in existing benchmarks; publicly available with leaderboard.
